export FP8_SUPPORT_ROOT=/xukang/code/pmd-triton-sessions/fp8-support-20261017
source "$FP8_SUPPORT_ROOT/venv/bin/activate"
export LLVM_SYSPATH=/xukang/code/pmd-triton-sessions/gemm-wdra48-release-3.6.x/llvm-build
